question: 单项选择：I _____ my grandparents last Sunday. A. visited  B. visit  C. am visiting  D. visits
answer: 答案：A. visited。解析：visit是规则动词，过去式加-ed变visited，与last Sunday过去时搭配。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：He ______ (go) to the park yesterday morning.
answer: 答案：went。解析：yesterday morning是一般过去时。go是不规则动词，过去式是went，不能写goed。

question: 单项选择：I _____ a new bike from my father last birthday. A. receive  B. received  C. got  D. B and C
answer: 答案：D. B and C。解析：last birthday是一般过去时。receive（规则）过去式received，get（不规则）过去式got，两者都正确。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (eat) three hamburgers just now.
answer: 答案：ate。解析：just now（刚才）是一般过去时。eat是不规则动词，过去式是ate，不能写eated。

question: 单项选择：We _____ a good time at Mary's party last night. A. had  B. have  C. has  D. having
answer: 答案：A. had。解析：last night是一般过去时。have是不规则动词，过去式是had。have a good time意思是"玩得开心"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (see) an interesting film last weekend.
answer: 答案：saw。解析：last weekend是一般过去时。see是不规则动词，过去式是saw，不能写seed或seeed。

question: 单项选择：My father _____ me a new computer as a birthday present. A. buy  B. buys  C. bought  D. buying
answer: 答案：C. bought。解析：句意暗示过去发生的事。buy是不规则动词，过去式是bought。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：They ______ (make) a cake for me yesterday.
answer: 答案：made。解析：yesterday是一般过去时。make是不规则动词，过去式是made，与原形拼写不同。

question: 单项选择：She _____ her keys in the classroom this morning. A. forget  B. forgot  C. forgotten  D. forgets
answer: 答案：B. forgot。解析：this morning是一般过去时。forget是不规则动词，过去式是forgot，过去分词是forgotten。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (read) an English book last night.
answer: 答案：read。解析：last night是一般过去时。read是不规则动词，过去式与原形同形，但发音变为/red/。
